items.description:
Is this link safe or a scam? Paste any URL from LINE, SMS, or email to instantly detect phishing, fraud, or fake websites.

🚨 Identify scam links before you click
🔍 Detect phishing pages (fake Shopee, bank, login sites)
⚡ Real-time check against 2.5M+ scam domains

Powered by 38 global threat intelligence sources, including Taiwan 165, PhishTank, and CERT.PL.

防詐騙網址檢查：貼上任何可疑連結（LINE、簡訊、Email），立即辨識是否為詐騙或釣魚網站。

🚨 點擊前先檢查，避免被騙
🔍 辨識假購物、假銀行、假登入頁
⚡ 即時比對250萬+詐騙資料（含台灣165等38來源）

Example:

Input: https://shopee-tw-login-check.com
Output: 🚨 Scam detected
Reason: Fake Shopee login page (Phishing)

Input: https://bank-secure-verification.com
Output: ⚠️ High risk
Reason: Suspicious domain (Reported by CERT)

Input: https://google.com
Output: ✅ Safe
Reason: No scam or phishing records found

Use cases:
- Is this LINE link a scam?
- Check suspicious SMS links
- Verify email phishing URLs
- Detect fake shopping or banking sites

latestVersion.changelog:
1. 明确市场范围。A 股（沪深主板/创业板/科创板/北交所）全管线支持；新三板披露流可核，但无连续行情流，估值/分位类断言天然不适用；港股披露可从 HKEXnews 取到，但科目口径映射与估值序列尚未建，相关断言按规则降级为 ⚠️ 而非硬猜。此前这些边界只存在于源文件的 TODO 里，使用者无从得知。
